visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Intro: Medium close-up showing a pan of golden baked rice topped with plump, pink shrimp and melted white and yellow cheese. A spoon lifts a portion, revealing the creamy texture and cheese pull. Studio lighting is bright and even. (2) Prep: A hand pours clear cooking oil from a small glass jar into a dark, speckled non-stick frying pan. The background is a warm, wooden countertop in a clean studio kitchen environment. (3) Shrimp oil: Dried shrimp shells are tossed into the pan and fried in the hot oil. The shells turn bright orange as they release flavor into the bubbling oil. The chef uses a red spatula to press down on the shells. (4) Broth: Water is poured into the pan with the fried shells, creating a vigorous steam and bubbling orange-tinted stock. The chef stirs the mixture to extract maximum flavor from the seafood remnants. (5) Searing: Freshly peeled and deveined shrimp are placed in the flavored oil. They are seared until they curl and turn opaque pink. The chef flips them carefully with black tongs to ensure even cooking. (6) Sautéing: Minced garlic and chopped white onions are added to the remaining oil in the pan. The chef stirs them with the red spatula until they become translucent and aromatic in the bright light. (7) Mushrooms: A handful of fresh Shimeji mushrooms is added to the pan. The chef continues to stir-fry, allowing the mushrooms to soften and absorb the savory oil and aromatics. (8) Rice: Cooked white rice is spooned into the pan over the vegetables. The chef uses the spatula to break up any clumps and mix the rice thoroughly with the sautéed ingredients. (9) Cooking: The reserved orange shrimp broth is poured over the rice mixture. The chef adds seasonings, including powder and pepper, followed by a splash of white cream and a block of yellow butter. (10) Finish: The seared shrimp are arranged on top of the creamy rice. A generous layer of shredded mozzarella and cheddar cheese is sprinkled over the surface before covering with a glass lid to melt.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins immediately over a fast-tempo electronic pop track. The speaker's voice is bright and enunciated, welcoming viewers. A sharp "whoosh" sound effect marks the transition into the first cooking step. (2) The sound of oil hitting a pan is audible as a low-frequency sizzle. The narrator's speech rate is fast, matching the 128 BPM beat of the BGM. Incidental metallic clicks of a jar lid are heard clearly. (3) Percussive sizzling intensifies as shrimp shells are fried. The narration continues with high pitch variability, emphasizing key steps. A "ding" sound effect punctuates the completion of the shrimp oil extraction phase. (4) A loud liquid splash and bubbling sound occur as water is added to the pan. The BGM remains at a consistent volume level, providing a rhythmic bed beneath the natural cooking sounds and clear narration. (5) Searing sounds return with a higher frequency "crackling" texture as peeled shrimp are cooked. The narrator's tone remains friendly and professional. Short "impact" sound effects are synchronized with visual text appearing on screen. (6) The final phase features a rhythmic mixing sound of rice and broth. The BGM swells slightly in volume as the narrator concludes. A satisfying bubbling sound is prominent as the cheese melts, ending with a positive vocal sign-off.
